name: MEGA-ACT LAYOUT PROPOSAL (2026-09-27): six Sonic 2 clips in three bands, a DRAFT for measurement only
note: NOT AN ACT. A measurement fixture for docs/research/2026-09-27-mega-act-layout.md: the six proposed clip rectangles at their proposed act positions and the two horizontal tunnels (832 and 1024 px, at least the default-rule 832), so tools/clip_act_bake.py can count the collision set, the pool and the camera-window page budget on the real rectangles. The four vertical shafts of the proposal are NOT here: the manifest has no vertical corridor kind (clip_manifest K3/K6 are floor-and-seam rules for a horizontal corridor), which is one of the proposal's unsupported items. tools/clip_rom_bake.py would refuse this manifest at region_plan (stacked clips), which is another. The act grid is 6x4 and not 5x4 because tools/ojz_entity_gen.py (ojz_strip_gen Pass 8, the INHERITED Oracle Jungle objects and rings) refuses a section count that is not a whole number of rows of 3. t3_hpz_mtz is kept although tools/clip_act_bake.py REFUSES it (K6: Hidden Palace has no plane-B floor anywhere, so at its east edge plane A says 16 and plane B says 0); the proposal's numbers were baked from this file with t3 removed, and that refusal is one of its unsupported items.
